belongs_to: Discussion: 'We did this multiplication as follows' (names of the parts of 2/5 x 3)
description: The expression '2/5 x 3' (stacked fraction 2 over 5, then x 3) in the middle. Two dark-red (maroon) speech bubbles with white text sit above it: the left bubble 'Multiplier' with its tail pointing at the fraction 2/5, the right bubble 'Multiplicand' with its tail pointing at the 3. So multiplier = 2/5 and multiplicand = 3.

belongs_to: Discussion: 'We then multiplied the result by the numerator of the multiplier, that is 2, to get 6/5' (arrow summary of the method for 2/5 x 3)
description: Top: the expression '2/5 x 3' with a dark-red bubble 'Multiplier' (tail pointing at the fraction 2/5) and a dark-red bubble 'Multiplicand' (tail pointing at the 3). Two curved arrows leave the expression downwards: the left arrow ends at a stacked fraction '2/5' (left column, upper copy) and the right arrow ends at the text '3 / 5 = 3/5' (written '3 ÷ 5 = 3/5', stacked 3 over 5) at the right. In the upper left copy of 2/5 the DENOMINATOR 5 is circled in red; a long curved arrow runs from that circled 5 to the right and ends at '3 ÷ 5 = 3/5'. Below it is a second, lower copy of the fraction 2/5 at the left in which the NUMERATOR 2 is circled in red; a curved arrow runs from that circled 2 to the right and ends at the bottom-right text '2 x 3/5 = 6/5' (stacked fractions). A straight arrow goes from the result '3/5' (of the '3 ÷ 5 = 3/5' text) down-left to the '2 x 3/5 = 6/5' text. Meaning: divide the multiplicand 3 by the multiplier's denominator 5 to get 3/5, then multiply by the multiplier's numerator 2 to get 6/5. Black arrows and text, red circles, maroon bubbles.
